title: Edelman-Rose Gamblegram
model: Illustrative Rose ratio: (exchangeable Na + exchangeable K) / total body water
arrangement: Three persistent panels; one initial reference; no return-to-baseline cycles

panels.title: SIADH
panels.interpretation: Idealised water-predominant retention; compensatory changes in body sodium are not separately modelled.

panels.title: DI
panels.interpretation: Water loss exceeds drinking. DI can also have normal sodium with adequate water replacement.

panels.title:
Nephrotic syndrome
CCF · Liver disease
panels.interpretation: One shared oedematous sodium/water-balance pattern, not an assertion that all three diseases have identical mechanisms. Liver disease refers to the cirrhotic/advanced oedematous context; hyponatraemia is not inevitable.
